name: Causal Push
scaffolding_intent: Entity A rushes into entity B with an impact burst, showing that A causes something to happen to B

parameters.name: entityPrefixB
parameters.description: Entity ID of the target receiving the push

parameters.name: impactScale
parameters.description: Size multiplier for the impact star

correction_intent: Child got the cause wrong or reversed it (the dog scared the cat, not the cat the dog; the wind, not the boy, knocked over the vase). Target the actual cause as A and the affected entity as B. Not for a wrong action of one entity alone; that is A1 or A2.
suggestion_intent: The scene shows one entity clearly causing something to happen to another (a push, a chase, a spill, a fright) and the child narrated the two as separate facts without linking them ('the dog runs. The cat is scared.'). Target the cause as A and the affected entity as B.
